# XNL HR & Communications

> Senior HR judgment, scoped by the project. Fractional HR and workplace mediation for owner-operated employers and not-for-profits. Headquartered in Newmarket, Ontario, Canada. Working Canada-wide on the right files.

XNL HR & Communications is a one-partner practice founded by Evert Akkerman (CHRL, LL.M.) in 2012. The practice was joined in 2026 by Wendy Akkerman to launch a workplace mediation service timed to the Ontario HRTO mandatory-mediation rule (in force since June 2025).

## What XNL does

Three practices, one senior partner each:

- **Fractional HR** (Evert Akkerman): Hiring, terminations, handbooks, policy, compliance (ESA, OHSA, AODA), performance management, senior advisory.
- **Workplace Mediation** (Wendy Akkerman): Independent mediation for workplace conflict, harassment complaints, termination disputes, HRTO matters under the June 2025 mandatory-mediation rule.
- **Editorial & Communications** (Evert Akkerman): Op-eds, board memos, technical HR writing, communications plans, book editing, EN to NL translation.

## Who XNL serves

Owner-operated SMBs (roughly 15 to 250 employees) and not-for-profits without a senior HR lead. Sectors include manufacturing, professional services, not-for-profit, municipal, healthcare, and retail/hospitality. Most engagements are Ontario-based. Canada-wide and federally regulated work taken case by case.

## How XNL is different

- One senior partner on every file (no junior analysts, no handoffs).
- Project-priced or capped hourly. No mandatory retainers.
- Engagements can start in under two weeks.
- 25 years of senior HR practice; 25+ published bylines in Canadian HR Reporter, Municipal World, Ottawa Life, Talent Canada, The Lawyer's Daily, HR Professional Now, HRD Canada.
